newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-HIH Winterthur buys CareAmerica unit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-HIH Winterthur buys CareAmerica unit.

text.p: Swiss-controlled Insurance group HIH Winterthur Ltd said on Monday it had bought back CareAmerica Compensation and Liability Insurance Co, a unit of Care America, for US$59 million.
HIH said it had set up the workers compensation unit, formerly known as Health Cal, in 1987 and then sold it in 1994 for US$93 million.
HIH said net written premium at the CareAmerica unit in l997 was expected to be in the region of A$140 million.

"This major initiative will provide a strategic operational focus for mainland United States business as well as providing infrastructure support for existing operations in Hawaii and Argentina and future expansion throughout the Americas," HIH said.

CareAmerica President and chief executive Robert White said in the HIH statement that it was important that CareAmerica maintain a strong focus on key niche markets. "The divestiture of our compensation division will allow us to strengthen our focus in the managed health care market and channel our energy, time and resources to our core customers -- employers, seniors and other individuals who are seeking high quality, affordable health insurance plans," White said.
HIH is 48 percent-owned by Winterthur Swiss.
